summary: Russian forces struck a temporary deployment point of the 159th Separate Mechanized Brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in Kharkiv Oblast with Su-34 aircraft per Russian MoD. Russian air defenses intercepted 105 Ukrainian fixed-wing-type UAVs over Russian regions in 12 hours per Russian MoD. Ukrainian monitoring channels reported multiple UAV, ballistic, and cruise missile threats across Ukraine including Poltava, Sumy, Odesa, and Kyiv.
key_points: Su-34 aircraft of Russia's Aerospace Forces struck a temporary deployment point of the 159th Separate Mechanized Brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in Kharkiv Oblast per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385721).
Russian air defenses intercepted and destroyed 105 Ukrainian fixed-wing-type UAVs over Russian regions within 12 hours per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385731).
Russian forces using Geran-4 Seeker UAVs struck three dry cargo ships in the port of Mykolaiv per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385727).
A ballistic missile was reported heading to Sumy and its outskirts per Ukrainian monitoring channel (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69101).
Two cruise missiles X-59 were reported heading to Odesa per Ukrainian monitoring channel (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69105).
A threat of ballistic weapons use from Crimea was reported per Ukrainian monitoring channel (Source: @kpszsu/68918).
Twelve shadow fleet vessels of Russia were hit in the Black Sea overnight per Madyar (Source: @UkraineNow/82712).
Russian command ordered intensified strikes on fuel stations, trucks, buses and cars by Rubikon center and external pilots per GUR (Source: @UkraineNow/82720).

sections.executive_summary: Russian Su-34 aircraft struck a temporary deployment point of the 159th Separate Mechanized Brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in Kharkiv Oblast per Russian MoD. Russian air defenses intercepted 105 Ukrainian fixed-wing-type UAVs over Russian regions in 12 hours per Russian MoD. Ukrainian channels reported widespread UAV, ballistic, and cruise missile activity targeting Poltava, Sumy, Odesa, Dnipropetrovsk, and Kyiv regions.

points: A ballistic missile was reported on Sumy and its outskirts per Ukrainian monitoring channel mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69101). Separately, a possible ballistic threat for Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast was warned within two days per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101395).

Russian forces attacked civilian infrastructure in Kharkiv Oblast, Odesa, and Dnipropetrovsk; one man died in Kharkiv and five were injured per UkraineNow (Source: @UkraineNow/82727). In Dnipropetrovsk, nearly 40 attacks by drones and aerial bombs wounded ten people (Source: @UkraineNow/82731).

Twelve shadow fleet vessels of Russia were struck in the Black Sea overnight with intent to paralyze oil and fuel logistics per commander Madyar (Source: @UkraineNow/82712). Russian Geran-4 Seeker UAVs hit three dry cargo ships in Mykolaiv port per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385727).

Zelensky appointed Oleksandr Poklad as acting head of SBU via decree 622/2026; Poklad is a major-general and former counterintelligence chief (Source: @UkraineNow/82735). CabMin appointed Maksym Tsutsikiridze as acting National Police head (Source: @UkraineNow/82736).

Protests against Commander-in-Chief Syrsky and for Fedorov's return occurred in Kyiv, Lviv, Ternopil, Odesa, Vinnytsia, Sumy, Dnipro per DeepStateUA (Source: @DeepStateUA/23660). A 'cardboard Maidan' continued in Kyiv overnight per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31686).

Russian command ordered Rubikon center and line-unit external pilots to intensify strikes on fuel stations, trucks, buses, cars per GUR (Source: @UkraineNow/82720). Verkhovna Rada voted to appoint Serhiy Koretskyi as prime minister (Source: @UkraineNow/82709).

Russian air defenses intercepted and destroyed 105 Ukrainian fixed-wing-type UAVs over Russian regions in 12 hours per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385731). No specific regions or weapon details beyond type were stated.

Su-34 aircraft of Russia's Aerospace Forces struck a temporary deployment point of Ukraine's 159th Separate Mechanized Brigade in Kharkiv Oblast per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385721). Video was released by Russian MoD.
Russian forces using Geran-4 Seeker UAVs struck three dry cargo ships in the port of Mykolaiv per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385727). The strike was attributed to Russian military UAV units.

Russia lodged a protest with Estonia's charge d'affaires over demolition of a monument to Soviet soldiers in Yygeveste village; 795 soldiers' remains unknown per Zakharova (Source: @tass_agency/385728).

Russian MoD collegium heard that updating the military construction complex allowed increased volumes of military infrastructure construction per Fradkov (Source: @tass_agency/385720). AI use in Russian Armed Forces and UAV specialist training discussed (Source: @tass_agency/385734).

Blogger Ilya Remeslo faces up to 10 years for fakes about Russian Armed Forces and will be brought to Moscow per law enforcement (Source: @tass_agency/385725). Russia protested Estonia over monument demolition (Source: @tass_agency/385728).

Su-34 aircraft of Russia's Aerospace Forces struck a temporary deployment point of the 159th Separate Mechanized Brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in Kharkiv Oblast per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385721).

Russian forces attacked civilian infrastructure in Kharkiv Oblast; one man's body fragments found after fire and debris, five injured per UkraineNow (Source: @UkraineNow/82727). Kharkiv City TCC assault on lawyer left her with group III disability (Source: @UkraineNow/82723).

UAV activity in Kharkiv Oblast included a reconnaissance UAV north of Kharkiv possibly acting as spotter, and a high-speed target toward Sumy per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68852). Two 'Banderyol' UAVs to Andriivka and guided to Prolisne reported (Source: @eRadarrua/101401).
KABs were directed to Donetsk Oblast toward Dnipropetrovsk per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68889). KABs also directed to Zaporizhzhia Oblast per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68884).

Dnipropetrovsk Oblast saw nearly 40 attacks by drones and aerial bombs; logistics warehouse, apartments, buses, homes damaged, ten wounded per UkraineNow (Source: @UkraineNow/82731). Slobozhanske/Pidhorodne and reactive UAV past Brovky reported (Source: @eRadarrua/101403).
Reactive UAV from sea to Chornomorsk and Sumy Okhtyrka reported per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101417). Reactive UAV east of Chernihiv toward Kharkiv Oblast per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68875).
A ballistic missile was reported on Sumy and outskirts per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69101). A high-speed target toward Sumy from north of Kharkiv per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68852).
Reactive UAVs east of Chernihiv course south per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68893). Reactive UAV north of Korukivka in Chernihiv Oblast per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101420).
UAV on Chernihiv Oblast course west, and north of Sumy course south per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68853). UAV north of Kharkiv course to oblast center per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68851).
Sumy Okhtyrka UAV from sea direction per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101417). Possible ballistic threat for Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast within two days per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101395).
Reactive UAV east of Chernihiv course to Kharkiv Oblast per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68875). Two reactive UAVs east of Chernihiv course south per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68893).
Protests occurred in Sumy among other cities against Syrsky and for Fedorov per DeepStateUA (Source: @DeepStateUA/23660). No combat details for Sumy beyond missile threat stated.

Twelve shadow fleet vessels of Russia were hit in the Black Sea overnight to paralyze logistics per Madyar (Source: @UkraineNow/82712). High-speed target in Black Sea to Chornomorsk per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68896).
Russian Geran-4 Seeker UAVs struck three dry cargo ships in Mykolaiv port per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385727). Reactive UAV from Black Sea to Odesa per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68902).

Two X-59 cruise missiles to Odesa per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69105). Another cruise missile to Odesa per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69107). Odesa civilian infrastructure attacked with casualties per UkraineNow (Source: @UkraineNow/82727).
Guided reactive UAV to occupied Kherson from Zaporizhzhia per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101401). KABs directed to Zaporizhzhia Oblast per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68884).
Threat of ballistic weapons use from Crimea per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68918). UAV east of Zaporizhzhia course north per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68848).
Two UAVs over sea toward Odesa coast per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101385). Reactive UAV from sea to Chornomorsk combat ongoing per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101417).
Russian air defenses intercepted 105 Ukrainian fixed-wing-type UAVs over Russian regions in 12 hours per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385731). No locations beyond 'regions of Russia' stated.
Su-34 of VKS Russia hit 159th Separate Mechanized Brigade temporary deployment in Kharkiv Oblast per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385721). Video released by Russian MoD.
Geran-4 Seeker UAVs of Russian forces struck three dry cargo ships in Mykolaiv port per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385727).

Ukrainian monitoring reported two X-59 cruise missiles to Odesa (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69105) and another cruise missile to Odesa (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69107). Ballistic missile to Sumy (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69101).

Multiple reactive and guided Shahed UAVs reported to Poltava, circling near Poltava per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69110, @mon1tor_ua/69113). At least 2 downings and 1-2 hits overall per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69108).

KABs directed to Donetsk/Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68889, @kpszsu/68884). UAVs spotted in Kharkiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Dnipropetrovsk with various courses per kpszsu and eRadarrua.

Russian air defenses intercepted and destroyed 105 Ukrainian fixed-wing-type UAVs over Russian regions within 12 hours per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385731).
Russian Geran-4 Seeker UAVs struck three dry cargo ships in the port of Mykolaiv per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385727).
Twelve shadow fleet vessels of Russia were hit in the Black Sea overnight to paralyze oil and fuel logistics per Madyar (Source: @UkraineNow/82712).
A ballistic missile was reported heading to Sumy and outskirts and a possible ballistic threat for Kyiv Oblast within two days warned (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69101, @eRadarrua/101395).
Russian command ordered Rubikon center and line-unit pilots to intensify strikes on fuel stations, trucks, buses, cars per GUR (Source: @UkraineNow/82720).
Zelensky appointed Poklad acting SBU head and CabMin named Tsutsikiridze acting National Police head amid protests for Fedorov (Source: @UkraineNow/82735, @UkraineNow/82736).
sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces demonstrate sustained multi-axis air campaign using Su-34 strikes, Geran-4 UAVs, X-59 cruise missiles, and ballistic threats from Crimea against Ukrainian rear and port logistics. Ukrainian monitoring shows near-daily UAV penetrations toward Poltava, Sumy, Odesa, and Kyiv, with at least two downings and 1-2 hits reported by mon1tor_ua. Russian MoD claims 105 UAV interceptions over Russian regions indicating reciprocal deep strike intent. Russian command's order to hit fuel stations and vehicles expands threat to civilian mobility per GUR. Political instability from protests and SBU/police leadership changes may degrade Ukrainian internal coherence.
sections.regional_response: Estonia drew a Russian protest over demolition of a Soviet monument in Yygeveste with 795 soldiers' remains unknown per Zakharova. Ukraine opened SBU and foreign intelligence archives on Volyn events and pledged exhumation permits after Zelensky's meeting on Polish direction. Ukraine appointed acting SBU and National Police heads and voted a new prime minister, while a 'cardboard Maidan' continued in Kyiv demanding Fedorov's return and Syrsky's dismissal. No foreign military response to strikes was explicitly stated in messages.
sections.intelligence_notes: Source reliability varies: Russian MoD via TASS asserts strikes and interceptions without independent confirmation in provided data. Ukrainian channels provide granular but fragmented air threat tracks (kpszsu, eRadarrua, mon1tor_ua) lacking outcome detail except mon1tor_ua noting 2 downings and 1-2 hits. DeepStateUA and ukr_leaks_eng report domestic protests and leadership changes indicating internal friction. GUR warning on Russian strike expansion to vehicles is a specific actionable indicator. Black Sea shadow fleet hits claimed by Madyar lack corroborating imagery in messages.
